name: meu-novo-projeto
description: Sistema monolítico Node.js + React + Baileys — backend em VPS via EasyPanel (Docker), frontend na Vercel.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspace backend
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
